summary: First E2E validation pass. Backend: 7/8 tests passed. Frontend: all 4 pages (/sessions, /sessions/new, /corpus, /benchmark) render correctly with Authority Matrix sidebar visible and required data-testids present. Full happy-path (upload CSV -> run -> awaiting_review -> review -> finalize -> export) works. Redacted CSV contains [REDACTED:A:NAME], [REDACTED:G:SSN], [REDACTED:H:MRN] and preserves the non-PHI 'notes' column. Corpus generation is deterministic (hash reproduces on identical params). Benchmark F1=0.7815 (>=0.78 baseline) with 15+ categories at recall=1.0.

minor.issue: Narrative TXT with 9 PHI values across 9 HIPAA categories (A,C,D,F,G,H,N,O,R) yields exactly 9 spans; spec expected >=10. All required categories ARE covered and all required values (SSN 123-45-6789, IP 192.168.1.100, NCT12345678) are caught. This is a count-threshold miss, not a functional gap. One span 'MRN: MRN-12345678' is merged (17 chars) because Presidio DATE_TIME/other rule overlaps with rule-based MRN; consider not merging across different hipaa_category to raise span count.

issues: React Router v6 future-flag warnings in console (non-blocking, informational only).

action_items: OPTIONAL: Bump narrative-flow span count from 9 to >=10. Root cause: rule detector for MRN captures 'MRN: MRN-12345678' as one span rather than one NAME + one MRN. Investigate merge_spans() cross-category merging in phi_core/detectors.py so that spans with different hipaa_category are not deduplicated when they don't share the same start.
OPTIONAL: Opt in to React Router v7 future flags to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_progress_queues is an in-memory dict; multi-worker or restart will lose SSE state. Acceptable for local-first design but document it.

server.py:session_upload hard-codes kind='narrative', subtype='txt' on upload; the real classification happens later in ingest_file (which overwrites). Correct behavior, but the intermediate lie in DB could confuse GET /api/sessions/{id} between upload and run. Consider setting kind='pending' pre-run.
detectors.py:merge_spans() prefers higher confidence but drops overlapping spans regardless of category; this can suppress legitimate multi-category detections (see narrative issue above).
detectors.py:NPI rule matches any 10-digit sequence then applies Luhn check on '80840'+digits; broad pattern may cause false positives on other 10-digit IDs. Consider requiring context word 'NPI'.
pipeline.py:ingest_file writes .fulltext.txt cache next to upload; not cleaned up on failure/session delete. Add cleanup.
server.py: no /api/sessions/{id} DELETE endpoint; sessions accumulate.
seed_data_creation: Generated corpus_us_20260420_2 (40 records, 71 gold spans, hash 2986b669d89595bc). Multiple test sessions created via API.
